$comment: Written by hand. A conversation-mode run that is offered two host tools, one that reads and one that proposes. The model's turns are listed in order: it reads, asks for a name it was never offered, proposes, and answers.
request: What does the policy say about receipts? If a pack is needed, propose one for me to review.

hostTools.name: read_policy
hostTools.description: Read one section of the expense policy.
hostTools.result: Section receipts: a claim above 50 USD is approved only when a receipt is attached.

hostTools.name: propose_pack
hostTools.description: Propose a pack for the person to review.

unknowns: Whether a receipt must be itemized.

turns.say: The policy asks for a receipt above 50 USD. I proposed a pack for your review; nothing is saved.
